nodes.meaning: bounded admission, timeout, worker, and aggregate-metrics coordinator
fixed independent engine set; checkout lock does not cover evaluation
shared atomic unique non-reusing evaluation epoch allocator
one engine connection and one SQLite transaction snapshot for one evaluation

invariants: transport fields never become authorization facts
untrusted values are SQLite bound parameters, never SQL structure
each admitted request uses exactly one engine and one transaction-scoped snapshot
concurrent requests may evaluate on different connections while epoch identifiers remain globally unique
timeouts do not release an in-progress engine or permit until its blocking evaluation exits
transport rejection and runtime failure are fail-closed
